name: GitHub
author: Enplace
summary: Link a project to its GitHub repo: pull requests move work, and Versions reads and bumps the version.
description: Links a project to its code on GitHub. Every 15 minutes (or the moment it changes, with instant updates on) it checks the branch, the latest tag and how many commits have landed since. With Versions on, it reads the file the version lives in for Versions, and opens the pull request that bumps it when Versions asks. Pull requests and commits that mention a work item's key (ENP-12 in a branch name, pull request title or commit message) show on that item, and the item moves with its pull request: opened goes to review, merged goes to done, and closed without merging goes back to doing. When GitHub says an open pull request can merge, its work item offers Merge (you confirm first); when it can't, the item says why, like conflicts with main, and can hand it to an agent to fix. A branch that mentions a key but has no pull request shows on its item with a way to open one, and Today's brief names work stuck on GitHub. Each move shows in history and can be undone; the plugin's Move work permission decides whether moves wait for you. Public repos work without a token; add one for private repos.

settings.name: Repository
settings.help: Pick one of the repos your token can see, or type owner/name or the repo's GitHub link.

settings.name: Branch
settings.help: Blank uses the repo's default branch.

settings.name: Move work with pull requests
settings.help: A pull request that mentions an item's key moves it: opened to review, merged to done, closed without merging back to doing.

settings.name: GitHub token
settings.help: Needed for private repos. A fine-grained token with read-only access to Contents, Metadata, Pull requests and Checks covers everything; give it Pull requests: read and write to merge from a work item, and Contents and Pull requests: read and write to let Versions bump the version; add Webhooks: read and write to let Enplace turn on instant updates for you, and Actions: read and write for the GitHub Actions plugin. Without one, GitHub allows only a few checks an hour.

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: A project's linked GitHub repo: the branch and latest commit, the latest version tag and how many commits are past it, and the version Versions read from the code. With work, the pull requests and commits that mention that work item.

params.name: work
params.description: A work item's key, like ENP-12, for the pull requests and commits that mention it.
